export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug 'avik-pharmaceutical-limited', address 194, Arvind Chamber, Gauri Studio Compound, Western Express Highway) reports 'Total Shipments 689 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 33', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. Exact row quoted: '2026-02-28 | AVIK PHARMACEUTICAL LIMITED | TO THE ORDER OF | Methylprednisolone USP (CAS NO.83-43-2)- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | JAKARTA, Indonesia | 29372100 | 1109550'. Additional rows seen: '2026-02-27 ... L.B.S.LABORATORY CO.,LTD ... BANGKOK, THAILAND | 29372900 | 1103904'; '2026-02-25 ... Betamethasone Sodium Phosphate USP ... CAIRO, Egypt | 29379090 | 9989579'. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 689 total shipments; 5 dated rows were actually visible on the free view (2 outbound export rows to Indonesia/Thailand/Egypt, 2 inbound import rows from China/France, 1 EDQM reference-standard import).
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs bill-of-lading records with destination and HS code, not by website claims: outbound shipments to Jakarta (Indonesia), Bangkok (Thailand) and Cairo (Egypt) in Feb 2026, HS 29372100 / 29372900 / 29379090 — consistent with the declared HS 293721 (steroidal hormone derivatives), so no HS correction is needed. The company is a genuine manufacturer-exporter of corticosteroid APIs, not a trader. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search returned a connection error and Google/Bing returned no relevant results, so domestic_status is recorded as unknown with null evidence rather than inferred. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views and are left null — not estimated. Note that the same page also shows inbound imports (e.g. 16-alpha-hydroxyprednisolone from Lijiang Synova, China; EDQM reference standards from Strasbourg), which is normal for an API manufacturer and does not contradict the export record.
